instruction: Enable loop mode in VLC so the video repeats automatically.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling loop/repeat mode in VLC. The evaluator checks VLC config file for 'loop=1' setting. Agent needs to access VLC preferences and enable loop mode.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly extracts VLC configuration state from vlcrc file where loop settings are persisted
Metric function correctly parses config file to find 'loop=' setting and ignores commented lines
Metric correctly handles expected parameter (directly accesses 'loop_enabled' from rules dict)
Verification logic properly checks if loop=1 is set, which enables video repeat functionality
Default value handling is appropriate (assumes '0' when setting not found)
Type conversion logic correctly handles both string and integer expected values
No postconfig needed - VLC settings persist to disk immediately after user changes
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Consider documenting that VLC has both 'loop' (loop single item) and 'repeat' (repeat playlist) settings - current check for 'loop=1' is correct for the standard interpretation of 'enable loop mode'
